# Golden device-protocol frames, checked by both the C# (server) and nanopb
# (firmware) tests. Every value here is a test value, never a real credential.
#
# Format: <direction> <name> <kind> <hex>
#   direction  d2s = DeviceToBackendEnvelope, b2d = BackendToDeviceEnvelope
#   kind       valid      decodes to the expected fields and re-encodes to the same bytes
#              ignored    decodes with no payload selected and request_id kept
#              truncated  fails to decode on both sides
#              over_limit nanopb fails to decode; C# decodes it, so the server must
#                         reject it by checking the field against its nanopb max_size
#
# Each test keeps the expected field values for every name and fails if this file
# and its table disagree. See the wiki's Device Connection Protocol, section 9.

# connect: request_id "req-0001", mac AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, protocol_version 1,
# auth_secret = unpadded base64url of bytes 0x00..0x1F (43 characters).
d2s connect valid 0A087265712D303030312A420A1141413A42423A43433A44443A45453A4646122B41414543417751464267634943516F4C4441304F4478415245684D554652595847426B61477877644868381801
# request_id "req-0002" and an unknown payload field 15.
d2s unknown_payload ignored 0A087265712D303030327A020801
# connect for "req-0003" with its last byte removed.
d2s connect_truncated truncated 0A087265712D303030332A420A1141413A42423A43433A44443A45453A4646122B41414543417751464267634943516F4C4441304F4478415245684D554652595847426B614778776448683818
# connect for "req-0004" whose auth_secret is 64 characters (limit 63).
d2s connect_secret_over_limit over_limit 0A087265712D303030342A570A1141413A42423A43433A44443A45453A46461240414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141414141411801

# paired, unsolicited after a claim (empty payload still selected).
b2d paired valid 2A00
# paired as the direct reply to connect "req-0001".
b2d paired_reply valid 0A087265712D303030312A00
# pairing_pending K7QF2M9X with 600 s left, unsolicited (code replaced at expiry).
b2d pairing_pending valid 220D0A084B375146324D395810D804
# The same, as the direct reply to connect "req-0001".
b2d pairing_pending_reply valid 0A087265712D30303031220D0A084B375146324D395810D804
b2d rejected_malformed_request valid 32020801
b2d rejected_unsupported_version valid 32020802
b2d rejected_credential_revoked valid 32020803
b2d rejected_server_busy valid 32020804
# request_id "req-0005" and an unknown payload field 15.
b2d unknown_payload ignored 0A087265712D303030357A020801
# pairing_pending with its last byte removed.
b2d pairing_pending_truncated truncated 220D0A084B375146324D395810D8
# pairing_pending whose code is 9 characters (limit 8).
b2d pairing_pending_code_over_limit over_limit 220E0A094B375146324D39584110D804
